estimates: This dated model shows the building that opened in 1972 in its later form, with the renovations recorded by the city. Pre-renovation features, enclosed exhibits and the replacement project are outside the modeled scope.

The old perimeter is mapped. Roof heights, number and placement of individual roof units, window rhythm, color tones and paving are estimates from written records and visible geometry in the survey outline.
The viewer date range begins at the documented map revision and ends when the original museum closed to visitors in July 2025. The building was subsequently demolished in September.

review.notes: Started with Qualla. Its cleared architectural photographs show other structures in Antalya. The two verified Commons CC0 originals show museum objects. Use the historical map, the city council’s written conservation survey and the architects’ written descriptions for the former museum.
